channel.desc: Thriller 2024 The extraordinary journey of Queen Maxima, from her childhood in Argentina and a fast-paced career in New York to an unexpected encounter with Willem-Alexander that would pull her into royal life and alter her fate forever. Delfina Chaves, Martijn Lakemeier, Daniel Freire, Valeria Alonso, Agustina Palma, Saskia Diesing, Marnie Blok.
